_doc: Story 020b: painted Town Map art (prompts: design/art/map-prompts.md). Read by MapCanvas / MapScreen (src/ui/map_canvas.gd, src/ui/map_screen.gd). region_path: one top-down region image per gym type id (%s), drawn cover-fit in the map window instead of the code-drawn sea and land; icon_path: one image per room type (wild elite rival center mart event boss) + 'player' (current position), drawn instead of the code landmark (prepare them with tools/art/prepare_map_icons.py: white background removed, 256x256). For each path the first existing extension of `extensions` wins; a missing file = the code drawing for that element only. region_darken: black veil over the region image (path legibility); vignette / vignette_width: dark edge fade of the window. icon_size / boss_icon_size / player_icon_size / legend_icon_size: drawn sizes in px. icon_shadow: alpha of the icon drop shadow; visited_saturation (0 = grey) / visited_alpha: look of visited rooms; glow: halo colour of the reachable rooms and next paths. trail_*: dotted path look over a region image (dot radius, spacing, colours); walked_*: the travelled trail (solid warm line); path_curve: sideways bend of the paths (fraction of their length).
